title: Fantastic Droid Warfare
front_description: Fully in command, Master Yoda directs the clone troopers against the droid army, implementing a divisive strategy. Overhead, Obi-Wan, Anakin and Padmé watch from the open gunship as clone troopers advance toward the battlefield. There, weird and gigantic Trade Federation spider droids fire at the Republic foces, even as lightsaber-wielding Jedi slash through oncoming battle droids.
back_description: Doug Chiang's design of the Trade Federation's spider droid war machine.
